newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran president visits quake-stricken region.
newsitem.headline: Iran president visits quake-stricken region.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani arrived on Thursday in the northwestern city of Ardabil to inspect the area where an earthquake last month killed nearly 1,000 people, the official news agency IRNA said.

An earthquake measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale hit the province on February 28 killing nearly 1,000 people and injuring more than 2,500. The quake damaged more than 100 villages and prompted Iran to appeal for international help.
IRNA said two tremors measuring 3.9 and 3.5 on the Richter scale hit Ardabil city on Wednesday, but did not report any casualties or damage.
The February quake left 36,000 people homeless in snow-swept mountains.
